card.name: Goblin Cegamente Leal
card.summary: O controle deste monstro com a face para cima não pode mudar.

textEvidence.text: While face-up in the Monster Zone with its effects applying, control of this monster cannot change. A control-changing effect cannot target this visible monster; a Set copy can be targeted. Recheck the lock when resolving an already announced effect and when temporary control would expire. Ownership never changes. The restriction is disabled by monster effect negation and does not protect other monsters.

card.name: Mataza, o Surpreendente
card.summary: O controle deste monstro com a face para cima não pode mudar. Pode atacar duas vezes em cada Fase de Batalha.

textEvidence.text: While face-up in the Monster Zone with its effects applying, control of this monster cannot change. A control-changing effect cannot target this visible monster; a Set copy can be targeted. Recheck the lock when resolving an already announced effect and when temporary control would expire. Ownership never changes. The restriction is disabled by monster effect negation and does not protect other monsters. In addition the same copy can make two attacks each Battle Phase while its effects apply; the maximum does not stack.
